objective_value: <float> Total cost of the solution, summing the per-arc traversal costs over all arcs used by all vehicles plus the access costs of every accessed edge set.

routes.vehicle: <int> Identifier of the vehicle that performs this route.
routes.sequence: <list[int]> Ordered list of node ids visited by the vehicle, starting and ending at the depot.
routes.arcs: <list[list[int]]> Directed arcs traversed by the vehicle, each given as an [origin_node, destination_node] pair.
routes.visit_times: <dict, key: '{node}'> Time at which the vehicle visits each node, lying within that node's time window.

edge_sets_used: <list[int]> Identifiers of the edge sets whose access cost is paid so that vehicles may traverse the edges they contain.
